intro: 电容和电感是**储能元件**：它们的伏安关系是微分（积分）关系，电压、电流取决于“历史”。这一章的四件事——VCR、储能、直流稳态（电容开路、电感短路）、换路定则——是后面一阶、二阶电路的全部基础。

en.intro: Capacitors and inductors are **energy-storage elements**: their voltage–current relations involve derivatives (integrals), so their voltages and currents depend on the past. The four topics of this chapter — the VCRs, stored energy, DC steady state (capacitor open, inductor short) and the switching laws — are the whole foundation of first- and second-order circuits.

ideas.title: 电容的伏安关系：i = C dv/dt
text: 关联参考方向下 i = C dv/dt：电容电流取决于电压的**变化率**，而不是电压本身。电压不变（直流）时电流为零；电压按正弦变化时，电流也是正弦，相位**超前**电压 90°。
反过来，v(t) = v(t_0) + (1/C)∫ i dt：某一时刻的电压取决于从前到现在流入的全部电荷，这就是电容的**记忆性**。恒定电流充电时，电压随时间线性上升。
电容电压不能突变（否则电流为无穷大），电流却可以突变。

en.title: Capacitor VCR: i = C dv/dt
text: With the passive sign convention i = C dv/dt: the capacitor current depends on the **rate of change** of the voltage, not on the voltage itself. A constant (DC) voltage gives zero current; a sinusoidal voltage gives a sinusoidal current **leading** the voltage by 90°.

Conversely v(t) = v(t_0) + (1/C)∫ i dt: the voltage at any moment depends on all the charge that has flowed in up to then — the capacitor's **memory**. Charged by a constant current, its voltage rises linearly with time.
A capacitor voltage cannot jump (that would need an infinite current); its current can.

ideas.title: 电感的伏安关系：v = L di/dt
text: 关联参考方向下 v = L di/dt：电感电压取决于电流的变化率。电流不变时电压为零。
i(t) = i(t_0) + (1/L)∫ v dt：电感电流同样有记忆性，初始电流 i(t_0) 记录了 t_0 以前的全部作用。加恒定电压时，电流随时间线性变化——可能先减小、过零、再反向增大。
电感电流不能突变（否则电压为无穷大），电压却可以突变。

en.title: Inductor VCR: v = L di/dt
text: With the passive sign convention v = L di/dt: the inductor voltage depends on the rate of change of the current; a constant current gives zero voltage.

i(t) = i(t_0) + (1/L)∫ v dt: the inductor current has memory too — the initial current i(t_0) records everything before t_0. Under a constant voltage the current changes linearly with time — it may fall, pass through zero and grow in the opposite direction.
An inductor current cannot jump (that would need an infinite voltage); its voltage can.

ideas.title: 功率与储能
text: 瞬时功率仍然是 p = vi（关联参考方向下为吸收）。理想电容、电感**不消耗**能量：p > 0 时把能量存起来，p < 0 时把存的能量还给电路。
储能只取决于当时的电压或电流：W_C = ½Cv²、W_L = ½Li²，与参考方向无关，总是 ≥ 0。
直流稳态下电容电流、电感电压为零，**功率为零但储能不为零**：电容有电压就有电场能，电感有电流就有磁场能。

en.title: Power and stored energy
text: Instantaneous power is still p = vi (absorbed, with the passive sign convention). Ideal capacitors and inductors **dissipate nothing**: with p > 0 they store energy, with p < 0 they return stored energy to the circuit.
The stored energy depends only on the present voltage or current: W_C = ½Cv², W_L = ½Li², independent of reference directions and always ≥ 0.

In DC steady state the capacitor current and the inductor voltage are zero: **the power is zero but the stored energy is not** — a capacitor with a voltage holds electric energy, an inductor with a current holds magnetic energy.

ideas.title: 电容、电感的串并联
text: **电容**：并联相加 C = C_1 + C_2；串联取倒数和 1/C = 1/C_1 + 1/C_2（与电阻相反）。串联电容（原来都不带电）上的电荷相同，电压按电容**反比**分配：电容小的分到的电压大。
**电感**：串联相加 L = L_1 + L_2；并联取倒数和 1/L = 1/L_1 + 1/L_2（与电阻相同）。串联电感电压按电感**正比**分配；并联电感（初始电流都为零）电流按电感反比分配，即 L_1i_1 = L_2i_2。
原来就有初始电荷/初始电流时，只能把**变化量**按上面的比例分配，再加上各自的初值。

en.title: Capacitors and inductors in series and parallel
text: **Capacitors**: in parallel they add, C = C_1 + C_2; in series take the reciprocal sum, 1/C = 1/C_1 + 1/C_2 (the opposite of resistors). Series capacitors (initially uncharged) carry the same charge, and the voltage divides in **inverse** proportion to C: the smaller capacitor gets the larger voltage.

**Inductors**: in series they add, L = L_1 + L_2; in parallel take the reciprocal sum, 1/L = 1/L_1 + 1/L_2 (like resistors). Series inductors share the voltage in proportion to L; parallel inductors (zero initial currents) share the current inversely to L, i.e. L_1i_1 = L_2i_2.
With initial charges / initial currents, only the **changes** divide in these ratios; add each element's own initial value.

ideas.title: 直流稳态：电容开路、电感短路
text: 电路在直流激励下达到稳态时，所有电压、电流都不再变化：dv_C/dt = 0 → i_C = 0，电容相当于**开路**；di_L/dt = 0 → v_L = 0，电感相当于**短路**。
于是直流稳态电路就是一个电阻电路：把电容拿掉、电感换成导线，用前几章的方法求出 v_C、i_L。C、L 的数值不影响稳态结果，只影响储能和过渡过程的快慢。
注意“短路”的电感上电流不为零，“开路”的电容上电压不为零——这两个量正是我们要求的。

en.title: DC steady state: capacitor open, inductor short
text: When a circuit driven by DC sources reaches steady state, nothing changes any more: dv_C/dt = 0 → i_C = 0, the capacitor acts as an **open circuit**; di_L/dt = 0 → v_L = 0, the inductor acts as a **short circuit**.

So the DC steady-state circuit is a resistive circuit: remove the capacitors, replace the inductors by wires, and find v_C and i_L with the methods of the earlier chapters. The values of C and L do not affect the steady state, only the stored energy and how fast the transient goes.
Note that the “shorted” inductor still carries a current and the “open” capacitor still has a voltage — exactly the quantities we want.

ideas.title: 换路定则
text: 开关在 t = 0 动作称为**换路**；0₋ 是换路前一瞬间，0₊ 是换路后一瞬间。只要电容电流、电感电压为有限值，就有
原因是储能 ½Cv²、½Li² 不能突变（否则功率无穷大）。**只有这两个量**保证连续：电容电流、电感电压、电阻上的电压电流、结点电位、受控源的电压电流都可能跳变。
换路前的 v_C(0₋)、i_L(0₋) 一般由换路前的直流稳态求出（电容开路、电感短路）。

en.title: The switching laws
text: A switch operating at t = 0 is a **switching event**; 0− is the instant just before it, 0+ the instant just after. As long as the capacitor current and the inductor voltage stay finite,

The reason: the stored energies ½Cv² and ½Li² cannot jump (that would take infinite power). **Only these two** are guaranteed continuous: capacitor currents, inductor voltages, resistor voltages and currents, node potentials and dependent-source quantities may all jump.
v_C(0−) and i_L(0−) usually come from the DC steady state before switching (capacitor open, inductor short).

ideas.title: 0₊ 等效电路：求其他量的初始值
text: 1. 由换路前的电路求 v_C(0₋)、i_L(0₋)；
2. 画换路**后**的电路，把电容换成电压为 v_C(0₊) 的**电压源**、电感换成电流为 i_L(0₊) 的**电流源**（方向与参考方向一致；值为零时分别换成短路、开路）；
3. 这是一个电阻电路（含受控源也一样），用 KCL、KVL、结点法求 i_C(0₊)、v_L(0₊) 和其他任何量的 0₊ 值。
受控源的控制量在换路时可能跳变，受控源的值要在 0₊ 电路里重新求，不能沿用 0₋ 的值。

en.title: The 0+ equivalent circuit: initial values of everything else
text: 1. From the circuit before switching, find v_C(0−) and i_L(0−);

2. Draw the circuit **after** switching and replace each capacitor by a **voltage source** v_C(0+) and each inductor by a **current source** i_L(0+) (in the reference directions; a zero value becomes a short or an open respectively);
3. This is a resistive circuit (dependent sources included): use KCL, KVL or nodal analysis to find i_C(0+), v_L(0+) and the 0+ value of anything else.
The controlling quantity of a dependent source may jump at switching, so recompute the dependent source in the 0+ circuit; never carry its 0− value over.

ideas.title: 两个典型现象：断开电感的过电压、电容间的电荷重新分配
text: **断开电感电路**：i_L 不能突变，开关断开后原来的电流被迫流过剩下的支路（例如内阻很大的电压表），会产生极高的电压 v = R·i_L(0₊)。工程上用续流二极管给电流留一条通路。
**两个电容经电阻相连**：两个电容的极板构成的结点上，总电荷守恒，终态电压 v = (C_1v_1 + C_2v_2)/(C_1 + C_2)。但储能减少了，减少的部分被电阻消耗，而且与 R 的大小无关。
这两种情况里出现的**时间常数**（L/R、RC）将在一阶电路一章详细讨论：τ 由从储能元件看进去的等效电阻和等效 C 或 L 决定。

en.title: Two classic effects: overvoltage when breaking an inductor circuit; charge sharing between capacitors
text: **Breaking an inductor circuit**: i_L cannot jump, so after the switch opens the old current is forced through whatever branch is left (say a voltmeter with a large internal resistance), producing a very high voltage v = R·i_L(0+). In practice a flyback diode gives the current a path.

**Two capacitors joined through a resistor**: the total charge on the node formed by their plates is conserved, so the final voltage is v = (C_1v_1 + C_2v_2)/(C_1 + C_2). But stored energy is lost — dissipated in the resistor, whatever its value.
The **time constants** that appear here (L/R, RC) are the subject of the first-order chapter: τ is set by the equivalent resistance seen from the storage element and the equivalent C or L.

formulas.name: 电容 VCR
formulas.when: 线性电容，v、i 关联参考方向（非关联时 i = −C dv/dt）。

en.name: Capacitor VCR
en.expr: i = C\frac{dv}{dt}, v(t) = v(t_0) + \frac{1}{C}∫_{t_0}^{t} i dξ
en.when: Linear capacitor, passive sign convention (otherwise i = −C dv/dt).

formulas.name: 电感 VCR
formulas.when: 线性电感，v、i 关联参考方向（非关联时 v = −L di/dt）。

en.name: Inductor VCR
en.expr: v = L\frac{di}{dt}, i(t) = i(t_0) + \frac{1}{L}∫_{t_0}^{t} v dξ
en.when: Linear inductor, passive sign convention (otherwise v = −L di/dt).

formulas.name: 储能
formulas.when: 任一时刻；只取决于当时的 v_C 或 i_L，与参考方向无关。

en.name: Stored energy
en.when: At any instant; depends only on the present v_C or i_L, not on reference directions.

formulas.name: 瞬时功率
formulas.when: 关联参考方向下为吸收功率；p < 0 表示释放储能。理想 C、L 的平均功率（周期性稳态下）为零。

en.name: Instantaneous power
en.when: Absorbed power with the passive sign convention; p < 0 means stored energy is being returned. The average power of an ideal C or L in periodic steady state is zero.

formulas.name: 电容串并联
formulas.expr: 并联 C = C_1 + C_2；串联 \frac{1}{C} = \frac{1}{C_1} + \frac{1}{C_2}
formulas.when: 串联分压 v_1 : v_2 = C_2 : C_1，只适用于原来都不带电（或只看电压变化量）。

en.name: Capacitors in series / parallel
en.when: The series division v_1 : v_2 = C_2 : C_1 holds only if they start uncharged (or for the voltage changes).

formulas.name: 电感串并联
formulas.expr: 串联 L = L_1 + L_2；并联 \frac{1}{L} = \frac{1}{L_1} + \frac{1}{L_2}
formulas.when: 无互感。并联分流 L_1i_1 = L_2i_2 只适用于初始电流都为零（或只看电流变化量）。

en.name: Inductors in series / parallel
en.when: No mutual inductance. The parallel division L_1i_1 = L_2i_2 holds only for zero initial currents (or for the current changes).

formulas.name: 直流稳态
formulas.when: 只有直流激励且电路已达到稳态（t → ∞ 或换路前“已久”）。

en.name: DC steady state
en.when: DC excitation only, after the circuit has settled (t → ∞, or “for a long time” before switching).

formulas.name: 换路定则
formulas.when: 换路瞬间电容电流、电感电压为有限值（没有冲激）；其他量不保证连续。

en.name: Switching laws
en.when: The capacitor current and inductor voltage stay finite at the switching instant (no impulses); nothing else is guaranteed continuous.

formulas.name: 0₊ 等效电路
formulas.expr: C → 电压源 v_C(0₊)；L → 电流源 i_L(0₊)
formulas.when: 画换路后的电路；源的极性/方向与 v_C、i_L 的参考方向一致。值为零时 C 短路、L 开路。

en.name: 0+ equivalent circuit
en.expr: C → voltage source v_C(0+); L → current source i_L(0+)
en.when: Draw the circuit after switching; polarity/direction as the reference of v_C, i_L. A zero value means C shorted, L open.

formulas.name: 电荷守恒（电容并联后的终值）
formulas.when: 两电容经电阻接成回路，极板所在结点没有其他支路；v_1、v_2 为同一极性下的初始电压。

en.name: Charge conservation (final value when capacitors are joined)
en.when: Two capacitors joined in a loop through a resistor, with no other branch at the plate node; v_1, v_2 initial voltages with the same polarity.

examples.title: 直流稳态下的电压、电流和储能
examples.statement: 图示电路已处于直流稳态。V_s = 10 V，R_1 = 1 Ω，R_2 = 4 Ω，L = 0.4 H，C = 50 µF。求 i_L、v_C 以及电感、电容的储能。
steps: 1. **直流等效电路。** 电容开路（拿掉），电感短路（换成导线），a、b 成为同一点。剩下 V_s、R_1、R_2 的单回路。
3. **v_C：** 电容接在 a 与地之间，v_C = v_a = R_2·i_L（电感短路，v_a = v_b）= **8 V**。也可以用 KVL：v_C = V_s − R_1i_L = 10 − 2。
此时电感两端电压为零、电容中电流为零，两者吸收的功率都为零，但储能都不为零。

en.title: Voltages, currents and stored energy in DC steady state
en.statement: The circuit is in DC steady state. V_s = 10 V, R_1 = 1 Ω, R_2 = 4 Ω, L = 0.4 H, C = 50 µF. Find i_L, v_C and the energy stored in the inductor and the capacitor.
steps: 1. **DC equivalent circuit.** Capacitor open (removed), inductor short (a wire): a and b become one node, leaving a single loop of V_s, R_1, R_2.
3. **v_C:** the capacitor sits between a and ground, v_C = v_a = R_2·i_L (shorted inductor, v_a = v_b) = **8 V**. Or by KVL: v_C = V_s − R_1i_L = 10 − 2.
The inductor voltage and the capacitor current are zero, so both absorb zero power — yet both store energy.

examples.title: 开关闭合：哪些量跳变，哪些量连续
steps: 5. **i_C(0₊)：** R_1 中电流 (12 − 9)/2 仍是 1.5 A，结点 a 的 KCL：i_C = 1.5 − 1.5 = **0**。i_C 是非状态量，这里只是恰好没有跳变。
**小结：** 只有 v_C、i_L 从 0₋ 连续到 0₊；v_b、v_L、i_2 都跳变了。

en.title: Closing a switch: what jumps and what stays continuous
en.statement: In the circuit V_s = 12 V, R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = 6 Ω, R_3 = 3 Ω, C = 0.5 F, L = 1 H. Switch S has been open for a long time and closes at t = 0, putting R_3 in parallel with R_2. Find v_C(0−), i_L(0+), v_b(0+), v_L(0+), i_2(0+), i_3(0+), i_C(0+) and the new steady-state values v_C(∞), i_L(∞).
steps: 1. **t = 0− (S open, DC steady state).** C open, L short: a single loop of V_s, R_1, R_2. i_L(0−) = 12/(R_1 + R_2) = **1.5 A**, v_C(0−) = v_a = V_s − R_1i_L = 12 − 3 = **9 V**.

3. **0+ equivalent circuit.** S closed, C replaced by a 9 V voltage source, L by a 1.5 A current source (a → b). At node b, R_2 ∥ R_3 = 2 Ω, so **v_b(0+) = 3 V** (it was 9 V), **i_2(0+) = 0.5 A**, **i_3(0+) = 1 A**.
5. **i_C(0+):** the current in R_1, (12 − 9)/2, is still 1.5 A; KCL at a: i_C = 1.5 − 1.5 = **0**. i_C is not a state variable — here it just happens not to jump.
6. **New steady state:** C open, L short, R_2 ∥ R_3 = 2 Ω in series with R_1: **i_L(∞) = 3 A**, **v_C(∞) = 6 V**.
**Summary:** only v_C and i_L are continuous from 0− to 0+; v_b, v_L and i_2 all jump.

mistakes.text: 以为换路时所有电压、电流都不变。只有 v_C 和 i_L 连续；i_C、v_L、电阻电压电流、结点电位都要在 0₊ 等效电路里重新算。

en.text: Assuming every voltage and current is unchanged at switching. Only v_C and i_L are continuous; i_C, v_L, resistor quantities and node potentials must be recomputed in the 0+ circuit.

mistakes.text: 0₊ 等效电路里把电容当开路、电感当短路（那是直流稳态的模型）。0₊ 时刻电容是电压源 v_C(0₊)、电感是电流源 i_L(0₊)。

en.text: Using open capacitor / shorted inductor in the 0+ circuit (that is the DC steady-state model). At 0+ the capacitor is a voltage source v_C(0+) and the inductor a current source i_L(0+).

mistakes.text: 用换路**前**的电路结构画 0₊ 等效电路。0₊ 电路的开关状态是换路**后**的，只有 v_C、i_L 的数值来自 0₋。

en.text: Drawing the 0+ circuit with the switch positions from **before** switching. The 0+ circuit has the switches as they are **after** switching; only the values of v_C and i_L come from 0−.

mistakes.text: 电容串并联套用电阻的公式（串联相加）。电容是并联相加、串联取倒数和，与电阻正好相反；电感与电阻相同。

en.text: Combining capacitors with the resistor rules (series adds). Capacitors add in parallel and combine reciprocally in series — the opposite of resistors; inductors behave like resistors.

mistakes.text: 看到直流稳态下 v_L = 0 就认为电感没有储能。储能 ½Li² 只看电流；同样电容的储能 ½Cv² 只看电压，与电流是否为零无关。

en.text: Concluding that an inductor stores no energy because v_L = 0 in DC steady state. ½Li² depends only on the current; likewise ½Cv² depends only on the voltage, not on whether a current flows.

mistakes.text: v、i 非关联时仍写 i = C dv/dt、v = L di/dt。和欧姆定律一样，非关联时要加负号。

en.text: Writing i = C dv/dt or v = L di/dt when v and i do not follow the passive sign convention. As with Ohm's law, a minus sign is needed.
